From 310f9d137c0e090f53c8d02e1c33b88de7086a6e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2024 10:25:34 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/xe/gsc: Fix kernel doc for xe_gsc_create_host_session_id

Fix documentation for xe_gsc_create_host_session_id which
was xe_gsc_get_host_session_id.

Fixes: 152f2df954d8 ("drm/xe/hdcp: Enable HDCP for XE")
Signed-off-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Himal Prasad Ghimiray <himal.prasad.ghimiray@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240307045533.1867892-2-suraj.kandpal@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gsc_submit.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gsc_submit.c
index 9a18f5667db3..d34d03248843 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gsc_submit.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gsc_submit.c
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ gsc_to_gt(struct xe_gsc *gsc)
 }
 
 /**
- * xe_gsc_get_host_session_id - Creates a random 64 bit host_session id with
+ * xe_gsc_create_host_session_id - Creates a random 64 bit host_session id with
  * bits 56-63 masked.
  *
  * Returns: random host_session_id which can be used to send messages to gsc cs
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gsc_submit.c`**
   - The function name in the documentation comment was changed from `xe_gsc_get_host_session_id` to `xe_gsc_create_host_session_id`. This change corrects the documentation to reflect the actual function name.

### Relationships
- The modification in the documentation is directly related to a previous commit identified by the hash `152f2df954d8`, which enabled HDCP for XE. The patch addresses a discrepancy in the documentation for the function that was likely introduced or overlooked during that change. The fix ensures that the documentation accurately describes the function's purpose and name, improving clarity and preventing potential confusion for developers referencing the documentation.
